title: Email: Fw: Information on Wages, etc.

content.text:
From: Stevie Blanchard <stevie@detroitguild22.org>
Sent: Wednesday, August 19, 2020 12:09 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Information on Wages, etc. 
 
1) The overtime exemption is signed by individual bargaining unit members. It is a waiver of overtime payments. The exemption is supposed to be calculated using the previous years overtime.  
When you moved from Web to TIgers they calculated the wage bump based on your web desk overtime which was much less than what you would work on the Tigers beat. You should be able to get out of this agreement annually. If you want after you settle in I can talk to Peter about getting you off this exemption before the end of the year.
2) Individual bargaining. The collective bargaining agreements allow individual bargaining unit members to bargain for wages and benefits above the contractual minimums.
3) We have contractual minimums. A 5yr + reporter's minimum annual salary is 48,778.08.

4) I wasn't able to compare sports reporters directly. 1 our data isn't broken out like that. 2 the group is too small to keep it anonymous. I broke out the exempt reporters. There are 10 exempt reporters. The median salary is $62,737.90, the mode is $79,692.56 and the range is $54,566.29 to $121,000. This data is from 2018. I should have new data in a week or two and can update this info, but I want you to have something before Thursday.

Administrative Officer
Newspaper Guild of Detroit
928-380-0286
